verdict.rationale: Codegen's agents work through git-native flows (branches, commits, PRs) that are inherently reviewable and revertible via git/PR review (codegen-docs-4, codegen-docs-20), and agent traces support debugging/monitoring (codegen-docs-17). However there's no evidence of explicit versioning, review, or rollback of the automations/workflows/agent configurations themselves (e.g., prompt history, workflow version control, undo of agent actions beyond git revert). Missing for 10: explicit automation/workflow versioning, dedicated rollback mechanism for agent-run changes beyond standard git revert, and audit trail of automation configuration changes over time.
